roadmap.title: Prologue and Chapter 1
roadmap.description: Spit on the coffin three times in the prologue, then clear the starting-area pickups and chicken tasks.

roadmap.title: Chapter 2
roadmap.description: Finish each chapter 2 task in turn; do the one-shot choices first, then the crafting, blueprint and combat items before repairing the Normandy.

roadmap.title: Chapter 4 open space
roadmap.description: Do the ship-damage achievement first, then clear coffins, turrets, stations, repair shops, the Dome and the teleporter.

roadmap.title: Chapter 5
roadmap.description: Check the blue ship's windshield after leaving the cell.

roadmap.title: Chapter 6 finale
roadmap.description: Bring blasters and medkits to the final fight; finish under 7 game hours for the speed achievement.

achievements.description: Every survivor deserves an Oscar. So it goes.
achievements.summary: Plug the hull leak at the start of Chapter 1 with the gum.

steps.text: Pick up the gum near the start, then use it on the leak in the starting engineer area.

achievements.description: Hidden achievement: spit on the talking coffin in the prologue.
achievements.summary: Spit on the talking coffin three times during the prologue.

guide.context: The first spit is forced, so you only need two more. The prologue cannot be replayed without starting a new game.

steps.text: When the coffin conversation gives you the choice, pick the spit option two more times.

achievements.description: An immortal Chicken on a stick makes an excellent dielectric. We do not recommend trying this in real life, unless you have an immortal chicken and an immortal you.
achievements.summary: Neutralise 3 electric hazards with your chicken.

steps.text: Use the chicken on 3 electric spots. Right behind your starting shuttle is an easy place to find them.

achievements.description: Hidden achievement: hit yourself with a crafted item.
achievements.summary: Hit yourself 3 times with the @item{Crap imposed by the developers}.

steps.text: Craft the @item{Crap imposed by the developers} when the task asks for it.
Hit yourself with it 3 times. You can do this any time after crafting it.

achievements.description: The artist can offend and draw anyone. Usually, this happens simultaneously.
achievements.summary: Examine the 3 drawn-on mannequins near the start.

steps.text: Fly left of the engineer shuttle, next to the wrecked TV, and examine the 3 mannequins. The drawings are on their backs.

achievements.description: It's warm in underpants, and you can hibernate in winter if you have a whole lot of them!
achievements.summary: Pick up the underwear in Chapter 1.

steps.text: Fly behind your starting shuttle to the male-shuttle wreck near the destroyable cardboard boxes and take the underwear.

achievements.description: You can solve any case if you know for sure who you want to blame.
achievements.summary: Collect the 4 clue items from the pink wreck below the start.

steps.text: Fly to the pink wreck below your starting shuttle.
Take the hammer, the condom, the note and the condom box.

achievements.description: It's indecent to fart on Earth, but farting in space can save your life by giving your body acceleration at the last moment.
achievements.summary: Use the booster for 5 minutes in total.

guide.context: The time adds up across the whole game, so you only need to keep the booster on.

steps.text: Take the accelerator booster from the toilet in the freezing zone, down and to the right of your starting shuttle.
Equip it and keep using it as you play until the achievement pops.

achievements.description: Hidden achievement: open a safe in Chapter 1.
achievements.summary: Take the contents of the fridge safe in the big orange paint area.

steps.text: Fly toward the big orange paint area to the ship with the fridge safe.
Take the eye below the safe and use it to open the safe, then take what is inside.

achievements.description: You are immune to criticism. You are simply THE best. Everything your hands get to touch and create is GENIUS. This achievement is unique and is meant to be given to no one but you. Everyone else has a fake copy of it.
achievements.summary: Repair the small airlock with the dispenser you built.

steps.text: Take the dispenser blueprint from the battering-ram shuttle where the @loc{Duct Tape Tunnel} ends.
Scan the airlock under that shuttle.
Craft the dispenser, take the materials for the airlock, and build the small airlock.

achievements.description: Someone else's pass works just like someone else's diploma: it allows you to connect to engineering terminals and boast that you're a hacker while simply touching "Yes"/"No" on monitors.
achievements.summary: Pick up the engineer ID.

steps.text: In the battering-ram shuttle where the @loc{Duct Tape Tunnel} ends, take the ID from the left-hand table.

achievements.description: The ignition of natural gas can cause not only a heated argument on some online forum but also a 20% increase in the flight speed with accelerators.
achievements.summary: Restart the centrifuge in the mayo-covered ship.

steps.text: From the military module, fly down toward the exploded core to the ship covered in mayo.
Scan and replace its thrusters, then enter through the hidden entrance.
Craft an ignitor and put it in the centrifuge.

achievements.description: When your life hangs in the balance, oxygen is left for one breath, the world is in danger, and death and suffering surround you — fly through all the rings!
achievements.summary: Fly through 25 of the 30 molten-stone, stone and metal rings in Chapter 2.

guide.context: The rings are molten stone, plain stone and the metal rings at the turbines.

steps.text: Fly through rings until the achievement pops. You do not need all 30.

achievements.description: Hidden achievement: die with the drill in Chapter 2.
achievements.summary: Kill yourself with the drill.

guide.context: This is a one-time chance at the start of Chapter 2, and it does not cost you progress.

steps.text: When Chapter 2 starts and you reach the Captain's Bridge, use the drill on yourself again and again until you die, about 4 or 5 tries.

achievements.description: When you jogged for three days in a row, prepared yourself mentally to serve in the army, boasted that you were going to be a paratrooper, and then suddenly failed all medical tests — can this be considered as "almost served", or not?
achievements.summary: Wear the army suit and enter the military module.

guide.context: Police robots still attack you in the suit.

steps.text: Scan a Comradnaut wearing an army suit.
Craft the army suit and put it on.
Go to the entrance of the military module and enter.

achievements.description: The vacuum cleaner can not only help to clean the apartment quickly but can also rush through space and time like a jet motorbike. So convenient!
achievements.summary: Craft and ride the vacuum cleaner.

guide.context: Two of the blueprints lie together where the @loc{Duct Tape Tunnel} ends. The third is in the armored module.

steps.text: Collect all 3 vacuum cleaner blueprints.
Build a base with a transport module and put hangar doors down at the turret area.
Craft the vacuum cleaner on those doors and ride it.

achievements.description: Labor turned ape into a... more muscular ape. You have unique destruction skills, now your delicate workmanship with the handy scrapper will cause more damage to everything you touch with it.
achievements.summary: Break a door with the scrapper.

guide.context: Do this before you take the engineer ID in the dispenser room. A second door is in the military module.

steps.text: In the battering-ram shuttle, go to the locked door beside the communications unit.
Hit the door with the scrapper until it breaks.

achievements.description: "It's a bad thing to destroy the whole garbage collecting infrastructure for selfish purposes," so my mother says. Although who cares, anyway? Isn't that a cleaner robot in the distance?
achievements.summary: Destroy about 10 garbage-collecting robots.

guide.context: The robots respawn, so do all of them in one session.

steps.text: Shoot the robots with the blaster. There are 3 or 4 beside the Knight Gun and 6 or 7 in the @loc{Duct Tape Tunnel}.

achievements.description: The dead people flying around are highly unlikely to say "wow!" to your highly polished brand new ZAZ but it's still nice to enjoy the ride with the wind... Or without it...
achievements.summary: Build the ZAZ-1 space car and drive it.

steps.text: Find the 3 ZAZ-1 blueprints: beneath the mayo ship, beside the turbine crafting station, and beside the bio module that holds the EMP blueprint.
Build the car on the same platform as the vacuum cleaner and drive it.

achievements.description: If you mess around with electricity for a long time, you might get immune to it. Probably. But it's better not to try it.
achievements.summary: Disable 6 electric cores with EMP grenades.

guide.context: You need about 12 grenades in total, counting the 3 used for the Bandit achievement and some misses.

steps.text: Find the EMP blueprint and craft the EMP grenades. The electrical engineering suit helps.
Throw grenades at the electric cores near the big turbines until 6 are disabled.

achievements.description: Completing the second chapter will be almost as difficult as completing the third one. That's how it is.
achievements.summary: Finish Chapter 2.

steps.text: Complete the 6 tasks that lower the radiation, then repair the Normandy.

achievements.description: Completing the third chapter will be almost as difficult as completing the second one. That's how it is.
achievements.summary: Finish Chapter 3.

steps.text: Unlocks by itself right after Chapter 2 ends.

achievements.description: It would be an awful thing to open coffins if we weren't talking about their back panel containing the control panel. And since it's all about the control panel, then all is well, and you can proceed to open it.
achievements.summary: Open 20 different coffins.

steps.text: Craft the magnetic key tool and open coffins. Return to the Chapter 1 area for more coffins.

achievements.description: Congratulations! If you didn't cheat, then you are helping the industry to develop! In some way, not necessarily in the right one.
achievements.summary: Answer that your copy of the game is licensed.

guide.context: The question appears once, after the third coffin you open.

steps.text: Open 3 coffins.
When asked if you pirated the game, pick @item{Yes my game is licensed}.

achievements.description: Scanning the dead product of genetic engineering will help the spacesuit to replenish its library of useless images. And it might be possible to sell these pictures to the newspapers if need be.
achievements.summary: Scan 3 mutants in the bio module.

guide.context: Do this before you use the bio module control panel.

steps.text: Blow open the bio module hatches with explosives.
Scan 3 cow hybrids in the glass containers.

achievements.description: It's very easy to determine a person's mental disorder by the color of his spacesuit. Especially if you're a charlatan. A real professional will try to find and add all the other possible signs of the illness.
achievements.summary: Take the tea set and the letter at the Tea Party module.

steps.text: Fly to the Tea Party module on an asteroid edge, right of the military module.
Take the tea set and the letter from the locker.

achievements.description: You are a rebel at heart, a rebel by nature, and a rebel by horoscope. Down with other people's advice! Stick your fingers in…
achievements.summary: Press the red button at the bio module control panel.

guide.context: Do this after the mutants are scanned. A different button ends the chance.

steps.text: At the control panel, press the red button when the suit tells you to press the green one.

achievements.description: It may seem that making a hundred or two shots is not so difficult, but when each shot is worth the cost of a whole space station, it's a completely different story.
achievements.summary: Fire the blaster 100 times.

steps.text: Take the blaster blueprint from the armored module and craft the blaster.
Fire it 100 times.

achievements.description: Attacking a security robot is a felony, even if no one saw you do it. On the other hand, it is still a felony, so there is nothing good about it.
achievements.summary: Destroy 3 security robots with EMP grenades.

steps.text: Shoot a security robot with the blaster until it is disabled.
Throw an EMP grenade at it. Do this to 3 robots.

achievements.description: It's really easy to herd cows in space: just pile them up in a heap and don't touch them until the rescuers come.
achievements.summary: Scan the cow in a space suit.

steps.text: Scan the space-suited cow at the bio module.

achievements.description: There's no point in heroically covering a barrel of a beam weapon with your chest. You can, if you like, but in this case, it's just not necessary. If you really want to do it, don't forget to turn the weapon off first.
achievements.summary: Destroy the armored module with the Knight Gun.

steps.text: In the turret area, disable the 5 turrets with the consoles next to them.
Take their power cells and power the Knight Gun.
Fire it at the armored module.

achievements.description: Finding and counting dead coffin robots is an interesting and extremely educational activity, although it's absolutely useless. If only there would be the living ones…
achievements.summary: Find every broken coffin around the Normandy.

guide.context: There are 10 or 11 coffins. Your suit comments each time you find a new one.

steps.text: After you lower the radiation, fly around the Normandy and reach each broken coffin.

achievements.description: If you press any broken button persistently, something will definitely happen. Maybe the button will break, or maybe even your finger.
achievements.summary: Press the broken start button on the Normandy wheel repeatedly.

guide.context: If you miss it in Chapter 2, you can still do it at the first diagnostic station at the start of Chapter 4.

steps.text: After the wheel is repaired, press start at the Normandy wheel repeatedly, before the ship is fully repaired, until the achievement pops.

achievements.description: Believing in yourself and never giving up, even when everything is useless and scripted, is breathtaking! No, you're breathtaking!
achievements.summary: Destroy 10 coffins in the final boss fight.

guide.context: The coffins respawn within 1 or 2 seconds. Bring 8 or 9 blasters and 5 or 6 medkits.

steps.text: Keep shooting the same coffin while it fires. The count rises when it explodes.

achievements.description: Living coffins are no joke. Some may think that such a situation isn't a big deal, but in reality, a dead thing being alive makes it a zombie, a zombie is a bad thing, a bad thing is a problem, a problem is serious, serious equals an investigator and an investigator equals a life sentence. In the end, do you really want to go to prison?
achievements.summary: Destroy 10 enemy coffins.

steps.text: Shoot enemy coffins in space until 10 are gone.

achievements.description: Properly disposing of synthetic animal corpses, you can save humanity from dangerous diseases and the fertile soil from senseless pollution. You can also enjoy magnificent gore effects but that's not what matters.
achievements.summary: Shoot all the cows floating in space.

steps.text: Fly to the exploded station near the Dome and shoot every floating cow.

achievements.description: Being the fastest is a real achievement! It's a real mastery! It deserves some respect! You hear, honey?! IT'S AN ACHIEVEMENT! =(
achievements.summary: Complete the game within 7 hours of game time.

guide.context: The game clock wraps back to 0 after 24 hours. A long run can still earn this by waiting for the wrap before the final dock.

steps.text: Play fast, or reach the final area close to 24 hours and wait on the Normandy for the clock to wrap.
Finish the game.

achievements.description: Shooting a machine gun is easy. Hitting a target with it is harder. It's even harder to hit a target with the shuttle's plasma guns when the shuttle isn't designed for them.
achievements.summary: Destroy coffinbots with the ship guns.

steps.text: After the ship guns unlock, fly to the targets and destroy coffinbots. A repair station is nearby.

achievements.description: Being able to orientate yourself is an extremely important skill for any traveler. Don't forget to mark the landmarks that are visible from afar, keep an eye on the moss on tree trunks, and don't forget about the North star and your compass. Especially, if you're not in space.
achievements.summary: Open the map in Chapter 4.

steps.text: After the warp, fly straight for about 2 minutes until the suit tells you to open the map, then open it.

achievements.description: One can listen to other people's advice forever, but it's much more valuable to think with your own head. You learn best from your own mistakes, as someone said... Or maybe they didn't.
achievements.summary: Touch every tree in the Dome.

guide.context: Touch the trees on your first visit without reloading. If you reload the Dome, the game marks every tree as touched and the achievement will not unlock.

steps.text: Fly into the Dome and touch every tree, including the last few after the Toucher achievement.

achievements.description: Hidden achievement: use the teleporter in Chapter 4.
achievements.summary: Use the teleporter next to the first coffin station.

steps.text: Fly to the teleporter by the cryo repair shop, next to the first coffin station.
Enter it and follow the suit's instructions to the end.

achievements.description: Sometimes, among a thousand of options, only one is the right one. It's amazing how you managed to identify it. The greatest minds will break their heads over solving this puzzle.
achievements.summary: Press either of the two buttons in the cryo station.

steps.text: At the cryo station, press either button.

achievements.description: A man's palms say more than the backs of his hands, elbows, or navel. If you want to appear a strong and hard-working man in the eyes of others, you can rub your hands to get calluses that will brutally scratch other people's hands when you shake them.
achievements.summary: Touch about half of the trees in the Dome.

steps.text: Fly into the Dome and touch trees until the achievement pops.

achievements.description: Spying on people is indecent, and spying on dead people is doubly indecent. Probably. The dictionary didn't say anything about it under the word "voyeur".
achievements.summary: Find the coffin wearing your underpants on the blue ship's windshield.

guide.context: This is possible only in Chapter 5.

steps.text: After you free yourself from the cell, go on the spacewalk.
Check the windshield of the blue ship.

achievements.description: Not everyone can save the galaxy, but saving it by just sitting on the couch is beyond comprehension. Keep it up!
achievements.summary: Finish the game.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 6 and the story.

achievements.description: They teach astronauts how to dock to airlocks even before teaching them how to use the space toilet. Missing the toilet is unpleasant, but not fatal — missing the airlock is a problem.
achievements.summary: Dock at an airlock 10 times.

guide.context: The same station counts each time.

steps.text: Dock at any station airlock by holding right mouse, and repeat 10 times.

achievements.description: With all due respect to the work of repair robots, they are useless competitors that consume resources. These guys are not subject to reprogramming and will fix everything that gets in their manipulators: shuttles, the liner's debris, vehicles, killer coffins…
achievements.summary: Destroy the repair robots at the 3 repair shops and at one coffin station.

guide.context: There are robots at the 3 repair shops and one at a coffin station. They are hard to see.

steps.text: Visit each repair shop and the coffin station and shoot each repair robot.

achievements.description: It turns out that if you bomb a liner, the anti-asteroid turrets go crazy. They go crazy by themselves, without any killer coffins' help. That's right. In any case, space will be much safer without them.
achievements.summary: Destroy all anti-asteroid turrets.

steps.text: Shoot 1 turret at the Accelerator, 4 at the Police Module and 5 at the Forward Module.

achievements.description: A quick and unexpected raid on the enemy's infrastructure is very effective, brave, and only a real space fighter is worthy of doing that. We can only hope that the coffins were really building these strange stations, and not destroying them.
achievements.summary: Destroy the 3 coffinbot stations.

steps.text: Find the 3 stations in Chapter 4 and shoot each one.

achievements.description: Someone always has to control an army, even if it's an army of crazy coffins. A coffin squadron without a general is just a bunch of stupid meat containers, and a coffin squadron with a general is also just a bunch of stupid meat containers, but with a general. That's a fact!
achievements.summary: Destroy a coffin general.

steps.text: Shoot a coffin marked with red arrows around a coffin station.

achievements.description: It would be more correct to call this reward "An Ice-Shooter", but it sounds weird. In any case, the fewer unattended blocks of ice of questionable quality in space, the fewer people will be poisoned by poor-quality water in the future. Well, that's sanitary!
achievements.summary: Shoot all the small ice balls.

steps.text: Shoot the ice balls, mostly near the cryo and coolant area.
One is inside a tube-shaped piece nearby.

achievements.description: Either a very drunk, or a very meticulous pilot who wants to get a special achievement in his career would wipe all the asteroids in the area with a bottom of a space shuttle. It's up to you to decide, which one you want to be.
achievements.summary: Damage your ship by crashing into asteroids.

guide.context: Do this before the repair achievements. Only collision damage counts.

steps.text: Scrape the bottom of the ship along a rough asteroid until the achievement pops.

achievements.description: It's fun to shoot with a blaster, but to shoot with big military spaceship blasters is a lot more fun. However, there is some bad news and some good news. The bad news is that shooting military weapons is prohibited without a license. The good news is that everyone who could have inspected this has already died.
achievements.summary: Raise the ship guns to level 4.

guide.context: Coffins keep respawning until their station is destroyed, so farm them first.

steps.text: Destroy coffins and turrets until the guns reach level 4.

achievements.description: A spring squeak, the smell of fresh engine oil, the noise of an angle grinder, and the fervent swearing of a mechanic — you can't find all this in outer space, and you never will. But what you can find is the creaking of your joints, the smell of fresh sweat, and the sound of blood in your ears. Space is a lousy place.
achievements.summary: Repair your ship 10 times.

guide.context: Partial repairs count.

steps.text: Use the repair shops next to the crazy AI, next to the cryo station and near the jump portal.
